notes: 'reserved*' is added: no source verb stands for it, and the asterisk marks a translator's supply (rules 7, 20).

The superlative chain qodesh haqqodashim is split as most holy (construct) + the (article) + things (rectum) in its first occurrence, and the second, articleless occurrence renders both morphemes in one most holy, leaving the rectum unrepresented under rule 22.

The lamed of s015 carries the appositional even, as at v.8 and v.11; marking it unrepresented and the even added under rule 30 was the competing reading, rejected because a morpheme stands in the phrase for the word.
